strategy.name: Multi-TF Pullback + Visual Confirmation
strategy.description: Multi-timeframe trend-continuation pullback. Monthly + Weekly + Daily must all show EMA9/EMA15 aligned in the same direction. On the entry timeframe, price pulls back into the EMA9-EMA15 zone. Numeric rules confirm alignment + zone touch. Gemini vision model then judges rejection angle (>40°), Change of Character, and confirmation candle type — both gates must pass before a trade fires.

indicators.ema_9: Inner edge of the pullback zone on every timeframe.
indicators.ema_15: Outer edge of the pullback zone. Also used in the alignment test (EMA9 vs EMA15 and slope of both over last 3 bars).
indicators.ema_200: Included on the entry-TF chart for visual context (helps the LLM see macro trend).

direction_bias.rule: Direction = bullish if EMA9>EMA15 AND both sloping up on Monthly, Weekly, Daily (all three). Direction = bearish if mirrored. Any flat/mixed timeframe blocks the trade.

numeric_gates: Monthly alignment matches (EMA9 vs EMA15 + slopes)
Entry TF alignment matches the HTF direction
Current bar on entry TF touches EMA9-EMA15 band (±0.5% tolerance)

required_all: coc_present === true  (Change of Character broken recent structure in the trade direction)
red_flags.length === 0  (no choppy structure, doji cluster, HTF contradiction, etc.)

long: HTF bias bullish (Monthly + Weekly + Daily aligned bullish)
Current bar touches EMA9-EMA15 zone on entry TF
Gemini confirms: angle_ok, coc_present, valid confirm_candle, no red flags, score ≥ 7
short: HTF bias bearish (Monthly + Weekly + Daily aligned bearish)
Current bar touches EMA9-EMA15 zone on entry TF
Gemini confirms: angle_ok, coc_present, valid confirm_candle, no red flags, score ≥ 7

exit_rules: Stop loss: placed manually beyond the most recent swing against the trade. Bot does not auto-compute.
Target: manually, to nearest structural zone with R:R ≥ 1:2.
Rationale: bot executes entry; trade management stays with the human / LLM for now.
risk_rules: Position size: 1% of portfolio, capped at max trade size
deployment: Local only in v1. Relies on TradingView Desktop running with --remote-debugging-port=9222 on the same machine. Cloud deployment (Railway) needs a replacement screenshot source before it can run remotely.
